final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM group_counts), ratios AS (SELECT ReportsTo, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / total_count AS ratio FROM group_counts CROSS JOIN total) SELECT ReportsTo, record_count, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER () AS difference FROM ratios ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
